images.caption: Figure 1:(a)Memory Solvability. Models may fail to answer questions even when the required evidence intervals are directly provided. Results are reported on the backward tracing tasks of OVO-Bench, the real-time video understanding tasks of StreamingBench, and S-EMBER. (b)Memory Necessity. We compare a memory-based method (FluxMem[1]) with SimpleStream[2], which uses only the four most recent frames, and a text-only baseline. (c) Our evidence-controlled validation protocol ensures both memory solvability and memory necessity, providing a comprehensive benchmark dedicated to evaluating memory capabilities in streaming video understanding.
